pages.note: Title page: Syllabus for Life Sciences (SCQP17)
Note box (i-iv) then syllabus box (box title repeats the paper title, not a row); 8 numbered items, each with a bold heading

nodes.label: i
nodes.title: The Question Paper will have 75 questions.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.
Techniques:
nodes.body: Principles and applications of chromatography, spectroscopy, microscopy, electrophoresis, centrifugation, blotting, PCR & radioisotope techniques

nodes.title: Chromatin structure and function:
nodes.body: Organization of chromosomes in prokaryotes and eukaryotes, chromatin types, centromere, Telomere and concept of gene

nodes.title: Biochemistry:
nodes.body: Structure and functions of proteins, DNA, carbohydrates, lipids & vitamins. Bioenergetics, Glycolysis, TCA cycle, Electron Transport System and ATP synthesis, oxidation and synthesis of fatty acid, membrane structure and function

nodes.title: Biotechnology:
nodes.body: Recombinant DNA technology, principles of gene cloning, applications of biotechnology in medicine, industry and agriculture, animal & plant cell culture, environmental biotechnology

nodes.title: Microbiology:
nodes.body: Diversity of microbes, bacterial reproduction, antimicrobial agents, significance of microbes in the industry and agriculture, antigen, antibody, complement systems, immunity, vaccines, plant virus, animal virus and environmental microbiology.

nodes.title: Molecular Genetics:
nodes.body: Principles of inheritance, linkage & crossing over, chromosomal aberrations, extrachromosomal inheritance, replication, transcription, translation, DNA repair and population genetics

nodes.title: Plant Sciences:
nodes.body: Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Gymnosperms, Angiosperms, Vascular system in plants, Economic important of plants, Photosynthesis, Photoperiodism, Vernalization, and Biogeochemical cycle

nodes.title: Animal Sciences:
nodes.body: Characteristics of invertebrates and vertebrates, anatomy and physiology of different system of humans, nerve impulse transmission, endocrinology, human diseases Apoptosis and cancer, inherited diseases, animal cell culture.

changes: Each numbered item had been split at the printed line wrap (first line, including part of the text, as title; rest as body); title set to the bold heading printed at the start of the item (e.g. 'Techniques:') and the text after it made the body. Wording, labels and order unchanged
